question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Redo with products table join
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
        AND 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) / 
            SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pq.prod_id,
        pq.calendar_quarter_id,
        pq.sales,
        qt.total_sales as quarter_total,
        1.0 * pq.sales / qt.total_sales as share
    FROM product_quarter_sales pq
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        ps1772.prod_id,
        (ps1776.share - ps1772.share) * 100 as pct_point_change
    FROM product_shares ps1772
    JOIN product_shares ps1776 ON ps1772.prod_id = ps1776.prod_id
    WHERE ps1772.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
        AND ps1776.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.prod_id,
        pt.total_sales,
        pc.pct_point_change,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY pt.total_sales DESC) as tile
    FROM product_totals pt
    JOIN pct_change pc ON pt.prod_id = pc.prod_id
)
SELECT 
    r.prod_id,
    p.prod_name,
    r.total_sales,
    r.pct_point_change,
    ABS(r.pct_point_change) as abs_change
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN products p ON r.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE r.tile = 1
ORDER BY ABS(r.pct_point_change) ASC
